title: Step in the Right State Component
statement: Let $M_1$ and $M_2$ be machines with $k$ work tapes over a common alphabet, with state sets $S_1,S_2$. Choose an exit state $exit\in S_1$ and entry state $entry\in S_2$. For every configuration $c$ of $M_2$, one step of the seam-composed machine from $c$ with its state embedded in the right component equals the configuration obtained by taking one step of $M_2$ from $c$ and embedding the resulting state in the right component.
hypotheses_covered: $k$ work tapes and a common symbol alphabet and input
Exit state $exit\in S_1$ and entry state $entry\in S_2$
